sample_grounded_answer.query: What is the minimum fire resistance rating required for walls separating a boiler room from other parts of a building?
sample_grounded_answer.answer: Under Clause 6.1.1.2 of the National Building Code of India [1], walls separating a boiler room or central heating plant from other parts of a building must provide a minimum fire resistance rating of 120 minutes (2 hours). Furthermore, all connecting openings must be protected by self-closing fire doors with an equivalent 120-minute fire rating [Volume 1, PDF p. 314-315].
